# CANDIDATE: SHOTGUN_SCALPER_STAGE3_PARAMS_EXIT_FOCUS

**Filed:** 2026-07-21  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** exit_change  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

The shotgun_scalper_stage3 grinder identified a parameter set that significantly improves edge capture on J's winner days while reducing losses on loser days. The hypothesis is that tightening exit parameters (earlier TP1, tighter stop, shorter time stop) combined with aggressive strike selection (ITM-2 puts) and volume filtering captures more of the bearish ribbon ride moves while avoiding whipsaws in choppy conditions. The chandelier arm at 50% allows earlier profit protection during strong moves.

## Mechanism

**Entry triggers:** Require volume ratio >= 1.0 (at least average volume) and strike selection at ITM-2 puts (strike_offset=2).  
**Exit logic:**  
- TP1 at +150% premium (tp_premium_pct=1.5)  
- Catastrophe stop at -35% premium (stop_premium_pct=-0.35)  
- Time stop at 15 minutes  
- Profit-lock chandelier arms at +50% premium (chandelier_arm_pct=0.5) and trails 15% off high-water mark (standard chandelier trail)  

This creates a quick-scalping structure: take partial profits early at +150%, protect the runner with a trailing stop once armed, and exit quickly if the move reverses (15-minute time stop or -35% stop).
